description: Change an existing webhook endpoint — flip `enabled`, repoint `url` after a tunnel restarts, or change which events it subscribes to. This closes a real gap: volanea_get_project_status will happily report an endpoint as `enabled: false`, and without this tool the only way to act on that was a raw REST call, so the server could diagnose a problem it could not fix. Partial update — omitted fields are left alone. The signing secret is never rotated by this call, so existing verification code keeps working.

description.description: Label shown in the dashboard's endpoint list.

enabled.description: False stops deliveries without deleting the endpoint or rotating its secret. The usual reason an endpoint receives nothing.

events.description: Replaces the subscribed event list entirely — send the full set, not a delta.

url.description: New HTTPS destination. Must be publicly reachable — deliveries originate from Volanea's servers, so a localhost or private address can never receive one.

name: volanea_update_webhook_endpoint

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

warning.description: Present when the new URL is not publicly reachable.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
